summary: Explains lookup plugins retrieve data from external sources (files, databases, APIs) and are evaluated on the control node; since 2.5 they're used explicitly in Jinja2 expressions with loop rather than with_<lookup>.
questions: What are lookup plugins used for?
Do lookups run on the control node or the target?
Should I use with_items or loop with lookups?

answer_card.title: What lookup plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Lookups fetch data from outside sources (files, databases, key/value stores, APIs). Like all templating they run on the **control node**. Before 2.5 they were mostly used through `with_<lookup>`; since 2.5 they're used explicitly in Jinja2 expressions, often fed to `loop`.
